title: 第一 章 陆行舟第 二章 陆峰
slug: 残鼎复元陆家修仙崛起路
content_zh:
天元大陆。
秦国边陲之地，青云县。
此地人烟稀少，灵气稀薄。
玲珑山，在青云县内乃是第四高峰。
陆家，便坐落于此山之上，也是青云县内四大炼气家族之一。
玲珑山上有一条一阶上品灵脉，支撑着陆家为数不多的炼气期弟子修行。
一百多年前，陆家老祖陆云天，本是一介散修。
他虽已达炼气巅峰，却深感筑基之路无望。
机缘巧合之下，他通过完成筑基家族夏家的某个任务，才获得了玲珑山的灵脉。
而后，陆云天娶妻生子，逐步建立起了陆家。
自此，陆家也便成为了夏家的附属势力之一。
一百多年的时间里，陆家不断发展，如今已拥有十多名炼气修士，以及数万名凡人。
陆家的修仙者都居住在山顶，那里灵气充足。
而陆家的凡人，则围绕着玲珑山的四周而居。
“云引行明道宽，天焕荣光世昌”，这十二字辈名号，乃是陆云天老祖亲自拟定。
陆家的孩童，但凡年满六岁，便会被送至半山腰的玲珑阁，接受灵根检测。
若是被检测出拥有灵根，便会被迎至玲珑山上，悉心学习修仙知识。
然而，拥有灵根之人实在稀少，陆家历经三代人的不懈努力，才仅这十多名修士。
玲珑阁，常年都有陆家修士坐镇守护，每三年轮换一次。
此地灵气稀薄，驻守于此的修士，修炼速度极为缓慢。

此刻，玲珑阁密室内。
一名年约十五六岁的青年正微眯双眼，打坐修炼。
他身着青色长袍，面容清秀，气质不凡。
只见他手中握着的灵石，光芒逐渐黯淡，不多时，便彻底变成了一块毫无灵气的普通玉石。
青年缓缓睁开双眼，无奈苦笑一声。
“无灵脉修炼，着实太费灵石了。”
年青叹了口气，起身走出密室。
今年，恰好轮到他坐镇玲珑阁。
青年名叫陆行舟，在同辈之中排行第三
如今已达炼气四层，身具土木火三灵根，所修炼的功法乃是外界常见的《引火诀》。
此功法能修炼至炼气九层，修炼速度一般，比较稳定，并无其他特别之处。
这也实属无奈，毕竟以陆家的实力，根本无法获得好的功法。
即便是这《引火诀》，也是陆家从外面买的。
陆行舟的三灵根，是陆家近两百年来灵根资质最好的人。
其余陆家子弟，都是四灵根或五灵根。
陆家现任族长陆引浩，炼气八层，是陆家当下修为最高的修士。
原本，陆引浩本想让陆行舟一直留在山顶潜心修炼。
可奈何陆家修士数量实在稀少，族中诸多事务皆需人手。
按照族规，陆家修士修为一旦达到炼气四层或者年满十八岁，便需为家族效力，以此换取修炼所需的资源。
陆家修士每月皆能领取两块灵石与一斤灵米。

然而，陆引浩却格外关照陆行舟，每月都会给他三块灵石与两斤灵米。
陆引浩此举，并未引得其他族人有任何异议。
毕竟众人皆明白，陆行舟乃是家族未来的希望所在。
content_en:
Tianyuan Continent.
Qingyun County, a borderland of Qin State.
This place is sparsely populated and has little aura.
Linglong Mountain is the fourth highest peak in Qingyun County.
The Lu family is located on this mountain and is one of the four major Qi refining families in Qingyun County.
There is a first-order high-grade spiritual vein on Linglong Mountain, which supports the practice of the few disciples of the Lu family who are in the Qi refining period.
More than a hundred years ago, Lu Yuntian, the ancestor of the Lu family, was originally a casual cultivator.
Although he has reached the peak of Qi refining, he deeply feels that the road to foundation building is hopeless.
By chance, he obtained the spiritual veins of Linglong Mountain by completing a certain task for the Xia family, the foundation-building family.
Later, Lu Yuntian married a wife and had children, and gradually established the Lu family.
Since then, the Lu family has become one of the affiliated forces of the Xia family.
For more than a hundred years, the Lu family has continued to develop and now has more than a dozen Qi Refining monks and tens of thousands of mortals.
The immortal cultivators of the Lu family all live on the top of the mountain, where spiritual energy is abundant.
The mortals of the Lu family live around Linglong Mountain.
"The clouds lead the way to enlightenment and the road is wide, and the sky is glorious and the world is prosperous." These twelve-character names were drawn up by the ancestor Lu Yuntian himself.
Children of the Lu family who reach the age of six will be sent to Linglong Pavilion halfway up the mountain to undergo spiritual root testing.
If someone is found to have spiritual roots, they will be welcomed to Linglong Mountain to learn the knowledge of cultivating immortals.
However, people with spiritual roots are really rare. After three generations of unremitting efforts, the Lu family only has these ten monks.
Linglong Pavilion is guarded by Lu family monks all year round, rotating every three years.
The spiritual energy here is thin, and the monks stationed here practice very slowly.
At this moment, in the secret room of Linglong Pavilion.
A young man of about fifteen or sixteen years old was meditating with his eyes slightly narrowed.
He was wearing a green robe, with a delicate face and extraordinary temperament.
The light of the spiritual stone he held in his hand gradually dimmed, and after a while, it completely turned into an ordinary jade stone without any spiritual energy.
The young man slowly opened his eyes and smiled helplessly.
"Cultivation without spiritual veins really consumes too many spiritual stones."
The young man sighed, stood up and walked out of the secret room.
This year, it happened to be his turn to take charge of Linglong Pavilion.
The young man’s name is Lu Xingzhou, ranking third among his peers.
Now he has reached the fourth level of Qi refining, possessing the three spiritual roots of earth, wood and fire. The technique he practices is the "Fire Drawing Technique" that is commonly seen in the outside world.
This technique can be practiced to the ninth level of Qi refining. The cultivation speed is average and relatively stable. There is nothing special about it.
This is really helpless. After all, with the strength of the Lu family, it is impossible to obtain good techniques.
Even this "Fire Drawing Technique" was bought by the Lu family from outside.
Lu Xingzhou has three spiritual roots, and he is the person with the best spiritual abilities in the Lu family in the past two hundred years.
The other children of the Lu family all have four or five spiritual roots.
The current patriarch of the Lu family, Lu Yinhao, is at the eighth level of Qi refining and is the highest-level monk in the Lu family.
Originally, Lu Yinhao wanted Lu Xingzhou to stay on the top of the mountain and concentrate on training.
However, the number of monks in the Lu family is really small, and many affairs in the clan require manpower.
According to clan rules, once a Lu family monk reaches the fourth level of Qi Refining or reaches the age of eighteen, he must serve the family in exchange for resources needed for cultivation.
Lu family monks can receive two spiritual stones and one pound of spiritual rice every month.
However, Lu Yinhao took special care of Lu Xingzhou and gave him three spiritual stones and two kilograms of spiritual rice every month.
Lu Yinhao's move did not arouse any objections from other tribesmen.
After all, everyone understood that Lu Xingzhou was the family's hope for the future.
